mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units, indicating increased demand for new housing, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates broader economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1500 units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek higher yields in equities.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are not significantly higher when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5% versus above (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.5% and remains low for 3 consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as inflation concerns rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a rise in GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic output, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are anticipated to rise.
failure_condition: Joint movement of INDPRO and GDPC1 does not significantly predict positive 20-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% month-over-month signals decreased consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates reduced earnings.
failure_condition: SPX does not produce negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances following a >5% MoM decline in RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, indicating inflationary pressures, the S&P 500 forward returns are predicted to be negative over the next 60 trading days as tighter monetary policy is anticipated.
failure_condition: The predicted negative relationship between the described monetary conditions and SPX returns does not hold (Rank IC < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances following a >200,000 job increase in PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: Stable industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, coupled with low unemployment (UNRATE below 4%), indicates a balanced economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates sustained growth.
failure_condition: The described economic balance does not significantly predict positive 60-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.04).
